id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_160.pack|cs_: "Good to see you well, my friend. And you, poor Luminary.
"Jasper... It was you after all!!
"Hee hee. You should cure that temper. You never see what's around you, so you always flail.
"Why did you sell your soul to Mordegon!? We swore to protect Heliodor together! Jasper!!
"...Why? You ask me why? You? Me? Ha ha. Ha... Ha ha ha ha ha ha.
"What's so funny!!
"Then I will ask you.
"Why do you always walk ahead of me?
"Why do you alone gain power?
"Why, Hendrik!!
"I will no longer walk behind you.
"Love, dreams, light, even friends... they mean nothing in this world.
"Only power matters. The power of darkness that rules the world.
"He who recognizes my power is the true king! I will not forgive anyone who blocks his path!
"I lost my hometown, my people... my friend left me.
"Even called a hero, I thought there was nothing I could protect.
"But not yet.
"I still have something to protect. If {var:1} is the Luminary who will save the world, I will be the Luminary's shield.
"Jasper... no, servant of Mordegon. I will take your life.
"Can you, my friend?
"Enough games.
"Hendrik! I will walk ahead of you. You will rot here!!
"Hee hee... Ha ha... Ha ha ha ha...!
"...Jasper.
"Hee hee. Hee hee hee. Hee hee hee hee.
"Hee hee. I am Tyriant, one of the Spectral Sentinels who received Lord Mordegon's power. I love darkness and hate light.
Tyriant
Tyriant
Tyriant
"I think... you wish for a wretched light. And above all, you are pitiful.
"The Lord of Shadows desires darkness. As long as I live, the pure eternal night will not end. Light will not return here.
"Hee hee hee. Now let us heal the tainted light."
